summary: State-machine-driven frame decoder: consumes a byte stream through a refillable stream object (at a2+20) and parses an 8-byte header (big-endian 16-bit length, a metadata byte, big-endian 16-bit width and height, and an element count), then decodes count elements of a packed format (3 stream bytes per element) into a caller-allocated element array of 84-byte (21 dword) records, publishing each element's color vector into a current-color field. Header validity, width/height/count guards, and a length-vs-count consistency check route to vtable error handlers with distinct state codes; on success the stream position is persisted back into the stream object. Called from CommandDispatchStateMachine (0x0051126A).

local_names.a2+0: caller dispatch object: vtable whose +4 slot is (a2, 1) notifier, +20 slot is state code, +24 slot is a 4-dword current-color vector
local_names.a2+4: pointer to allocator vtable whose slot 0 is (a2, 1, size)
local_names.a2+20: stream object {[0] current buffer, [1] remaining count, [3] refill callback}
local_names.a2+196: element array pointer, allocated on first decode
local_names.a2+200: flag byte set from argument a1
local_names.a2+201: flag byte set from argument a3
local_names.a2+376: value copied into current-color field element 0
local_names.a2+400: pointer to object whose +81 is the decoded-flag byte

operations.description: Load the stream object v3 = *(a2 + 20) and snapshot its current buffer (v3[0]) and remaining count (v3[1]); store the two argument flag bytes at *(a2 + 200) = a1 and *(a2 + 201) = a3.

Stream refill guard (repeatable): when the remaining count is zero, call the refill callback v3[3](a2); if it returns zero the decode fails returning 0, otherwise re-snapshot the new buffer and remaining count from the stream object.

Read the header length as a big-endian 16-bit value: first stream byte shifted into the high byte (v40 = byte1 << 8) added to the second byte (v41 = byte2 + v40); derive the body length v42 = v41 - 8.
Read the third stream byte into the metadata field *(a2 + 192) = v9.
Read width and height as big-endian 16-bit values: width *(a2 + 28) = (byte4 << 8) + byte5 and height *(a2 + 24) = (byte6 << 8) + byte7.
Read the eighth stream byte as the element count *(a2 + 32) = *v16.

Publish the header to the caller object: v18 at (*(a2)) + 24 receives [*(a2 + 376), *(a2 + 24), *(a2 + 28), *(a2 + 32)] (value, height, width, count); set the state code at (*(a2)) + 20 to 99 and notify via the vtable +4 call (a2, 1).
Decoded-flag guard: when the byte at (*(a2 + 400)) + 81 is set, set the state code to 57 and invoke the vtable slot 0 handler (a2).
Validity guard: when width or height is zero, or count <= 0, set the state code to 31 and invoke the vtable slot 0 handler (a2).
Length consistency guard: when the body length v42 != 3 * count, set the state code to 9 and invoke the vtable slot 0 handler (a2).
Buffer allocation: when *(a2 + 196) is null, allocate the element array through the allocator vtable at (a2 + 4) slot 0 with (a2, 1, 84 * count) and store the result at *(a2 + 196).

Element decode loop: for index v28 in [0, count), write the index into the element record at v20[1], stream-read a byte into v20[0] (primary color), stream-read a byte split into v20[2] = (byte >> 4) & 0xF and v20[3] = byte & 0xF, stream-read a byte into v20[4], publish the element color vector into the current-color field (v27[0..3] at (*(a2)) + 24), set the state code to 100, notify via the vtable +4 call (a2, 1), and advance the element pointer by 21 dwords.
Finalize the decode: set the decoded flag byte at (*(a2 + 400)) + 81 to 1 and persist the stream position back into the stream object (v3[1] = remaining count, *v3 = current buffer).
Return 1 on a completed decode; return 0 only when a stream refill callback fails.
